subject: Exec intro + demo cadence for Auralis Health — scope & timing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auralishealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec intro + demo cadence for Auralis Health — scope & timing

Samantha — great to meet you last week on the call. Per our conversation I wanted to lock the executive intro portion for the upcoming demo so we make the best use of Miguel's time. Two options that work on our side: 

- Option A: Tue Jun 4, 14:00–14:45 PT (we split 20 min exec + 25 min product deep-dive)
- Option B: Wed Jun 5, 09:00–09:45 PT (more time for Q&A, same split)

If Miguel prefers a single contiguous 45-min slot we can do that; otherwise we can run a 30-min executive-first agenda and then offer the deep-dive as a follow-up with the product lead. I attached a one-pager and a suggested agenda for the exec segment.

Quick ask: can you confirm which option aligns best with Miguel's calendar and whether you'd like the VP/exec segment first or at the end? Rishi (cc) will run the product deep-dive. Priyom (cc) will own the follow-up/action plan.

Attachments: 20290530-exec-demo-agenda.pdf, auralis-exec-onepager.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auralishealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo cadence for Auralis Health — scope & timing

Kimberly — thanks for the options and the materials. Option A on Tue Jun 4 at 14:00 PT looks best for our execs right now. Two notes from Miguel:

1) He may need up to 45 minutes if we plan to cover a short strategy section + integration questions (he's leaning toward the longer contiguous slot).
2) He asked for a one-page summary of the business impact (cost & latency runway) to share with his CFO before the meeting.

I attached a short "ask" from our side (we'll send any final attendee names later). If you can prepare a 1-slide ROI summary and the agenda with the exec highlights first, that would be ideal. If Miguel can't make the full 45, Samantha (me) will cover the exec portion and Miguel will join for the Q&A portion.

Attachments: auralis-exec-asks.txt

—Samantha
Samantha Jones
VP Product, Auralis Health
samantha.jones@auralishealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-31T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Auralis exec demo — contingency and slide requests

Folks — quick internal note so we're aligned before I reply with confirmation. Samantha confirmed Tue Jun 4 at 14:00 PT but Miguel may need the full 45. Action items: 

- Rishi: please draft a 1-slide ROI summary (cost per 1k tokens, latency delta vs their current infra, expected infra savings) and a 2-slide product highlights deck focused on security/compliance. 
- Priyom: prep the mutual action plan template and the short post-demo MOP (3 milestones + owners).

If Miguel can't make the whole slot we will: (a) run the exec 20-min condensed brief first, (b) hand to Samantha (VP) for any follow-up exec questions, and (c) continue the deep-dive with product. We should also include the proposed mutual action plan in the calendar invite so procurement sees next steps up front.

I'll send the final calendar once Rishi's slide is in place.

Kim
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auralishealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@auralishealth.com>, calendar+auralis@cal.com
Date: 2029-05-31T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo cadence for Auralis Health — scope & timing

Kim — quick update: Miguel's schedule just tightened for Tue Jun 4. He can join for roughly the first 20 minutes but needs to drop for another commitment. I can (and will) stay for the full session to run the exec portion if he can't. Two possibilities:

A) Keep Tue Jun 4, 14:00 PT as planned. We do the exec-first 20 minutes with Miguel (if present) + Samantha, then continue with the deep-dive. Miguel will jump back in at the end if time permits.
B) Move to Thu Jun 6, 11:00–11:45 PT so Miguel can be present for the full 45.

Which do you prefer? If you're fine with A, please include an agenda that puts the exec highlights up front and call out the exact 0–20 minute slot for Miguel. If you prefer B, please propose two alternate times (we may need to coordinate with procurement).

Also attaching a quick calendar placeholder for Thu Jun 6 in case we decide to move.

Thanks — Samantha
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auralishealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@auralishealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo cadence for Auralis Health — scope & timing

Thanks for the update Samantha — appreciate the flexibility. Let's go with Plan A (keep Tue Jun 4 at 14:00 PT) and run a clear exec-first agenda: 0–20 min exec highlights (ROI, compliance risk reduction, procurement timeline), 20–45 min product deep-dive & integrations. If Miguel drops after 20 min that's fine; Samantha will carry the exec thread. If Miguel confirms he can extend we will keep the Q&A open.

I've attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx and the updated calendar event (auralis-demo-event.ics) that includes the agenda and linked HubSpot record HS-3456721. Rishi — please add the single-slide ROI at the top of the deck and drop the final PDF to the shared Drive folder before EOD tomorrow. Priyom — I'll ask procurement to review the mutual action plan after the call.

Links: https://cal.com/kimberly/auralis-demo (calendar invite), HubSpot:HS-3456721 (deal record)

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, auralis-demo-event.ics

See you all Tue — I'll send the official invite once Rishi's PDF is added.

Best,
